mf_newforms.description: Classical holomorphic newforms on Gamma_0(N). Each row is a Galois orbit.

columns.label: text — Unique label N.k.c.x, e.g. '11.2.a.a'.
columns.space_label: text — Label of the parent newspace N.k.c.
columns.hecke_orbit: integer — Orbit index within the newspace.
columns.dim: integer — Dimension of Galois orbit over Q.
columns.relative_dim: integer — Dimension over the character field.
columns.is_polredabs: boolean — Whether the field polynomial is polredabs-reduced.
columns.is_maximal: boolean — Whether this is the maximal Hecke orbit.
columns.is_largest: boolean — Whether this is the largest Hecke orbit.
columns.nf_label: text — LMFDB label of Hecke field as number field. Null for dim=1.

columns.analytic_rank_proved: boolean — Whether analytic rank is rigorously proved.

columns.is_self_twist: boolean — Whether form is a self-twist.
columns.is_cm: boolean — Whether the form has CM.
columns.is_rm: boolean — Whether the form has RM.
columns.has_non_self_twist: smallint — 1 if a character twist gives a non-isomorphic form.

columns.rm_discs: integer[] — Positive discriminants D s.t. form has RM.
columns.minimal_twist: text — Label of the twist-minimal form.
columns.char_orbit_label: text — Galois orbit of the character as a letter; 'a' = trivial. NOT char_label.
columns.char_orbit_index: smallint — Integer index of character orbit; 1 = trivial.
columns.char_order: integer — Order of chi; 1 = trivial, 2 = real/quadratic.
columns.char_conductor: integer — Conductor of chi; 1 for trivial character.
columns.char_is_real: boolean — Whether chi takes only real values.
columns.char_is_minimal: boolean — Whether the character is minimal.
columns.char_parity: smallint — Parity of chi: +1 even, -1 odd.
columns.char_values: jsonb — Values of character on generators.
columns.conrey_index: integer — Conrey index n; full label = level.n.
columns.prim_orbit_index: smallint — Orbit index of the primitive character.

columns.projective_field_label: text — LMFDB label of projective field.
columns.artin_degree: integer — Degree of Artin representation for weight-1 forms.
columns.artin_image: text — Artin image label for weight-1 forms.
columns.artin_field_label: text — LMFDB label of Artin field.
columns.traces: numeric[] — Hecke traces a_n for n=1..1000.
columns.trace_display: numeric[] — First few Hecke traces for display.
columns.trace_moments: numeric[] — Moments of Hecke trace distribution.
columns.trace_zratio: numeric — Zero ratio statistic for traces.
columns.related_objects: text[] — Labels of related LMFDB objects.
columns.level_is_prime_power: boolean — Whether N is a prime power.
columns.level_is_prime_square: boolean — Whether N is a prime square.
columns.level_is_square: boolean — Whether N is a perfect square.
columns.level_is_powerful: boolean — Whether N is powerful (every prime divides to at least the second power).
